headline: Ghana 2027 Budget Projects Debt at 47.5% of GDP as Cedi Weakening Projected
summary: Ghana presented its budget showing national debt stood at 47.5% of GDP in October 2026, while Fitch Solutions forecast the cedi will average 12.40 per US dollar in 2027.
why: Ghana is currently implementing debt restructuring programs to regain fiscal stability and access credit markets.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Sovereign debt metrics exceeded initial public target levels.
